programme.title: Lost Treasures of Egypt: Four Queens Compilation
programme.desc: In ancient Egypt, royal power was reserved for men, but over the centuries, women also sat on the throne.Some ruled as queens, others were crowned pharaoh.The figures of Cleopatra and Nefertiti still exist in popular culture today.The former, due to her alliances with Julius Caesar and Mark Antony, was remembered as an ambitious ruler of extraordinary beauty who excelled in the role of a politician and strategist.Her dramatic fate and suicide death have fired up the imagination of subsequent generations for over two thousand years.The authors will also talk about other extraordinary Egyptian women.Viewers will learn the fate of Hatshepsut, who was the longest-reigning female pharaoh, and Nefertari, the influential wife of Ramesses II.All of them went down in the history of this highly developed civilization.The creators will explain how they reached for titles and power.

programme.desc: While landing in Düsseldorf, the turboprop flying Nürnberger Flugdienst 108 crashes. Everyone on board is killed.As part of the investigation, elements of the wreck from the disaster area should be secured.The experts face a real challenge - they must reconstruct the entire machine to determine the causes of the tragedy.The discovery of evidence of a lightning strike is a breakthrough in the case.It turns out that the discharge damaged the electrical system, which resulted in a loss of power.
